summary: XBP Global Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a private placement securities purchase agreement dated September 11, 2026, for 2,275,245 common shares at a weighted price of approximately $2.66 per share, generating about $6.05 million in gross proceeds. Related-party purchasers include HCI, LLC (HGM affiliate, 204,946 shares), Avenue Capital-managed funds (600,000 shares), CEO Jonovic (31,500) and CFO Avramovic (8,833), at $2.83; remaining shares at $2.55. Closing expected by September 15, 2026. This is an ordinary unregistered equity financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and related-party pricing.
